children: said it has appointed Michael Akkerman as chief executive officer, effective Nov. 2, succeeding founder Or Offer, who is stepping down after nearly two decades leading the digital data and analytics company. SMWB stock jumped 5% in premarket trading on Thursday.
Akkerman was most recently chief business officer at Digital Turbine (APPS), where he oversees sales, partnerships, marketing, product and business operations. APPS shares are down 7%.
He previously served as chief revenue officer at data.ai and held senior roles at Cardlytics, Uber
Offer will remain involved during a transition period to support Akkerman and the board, the company said.
Similarweb said there will be no change to its strategy, operations, or financial outlook following the leadership change.
The company said it remains focused on expanding its AI-powered data products and its sales operations.

title: Similarweb appoints Digital Turbine exec. Akkerman as new CEO
